versions.changelog:
Praesidia 0.1.0 – Initial Release

- Adds agent verification, including trust scores and compliance checks.
- Enables discovery of public marketplace agents using advanced filters.
- Introduces guardrail management: list, apply, and validate guardrails (security, content, compliance, etc.).
- Supports fetching Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol cards for interoperability.
- Offers a comprehensive quick reference for core API use cases.
